name: pnp-powerplatform-prompts-timesheet-app
title: Timesheet App
shortDescription: Weekly timesheet Power App with multi-entry-per-day time logging, project and task type selection, running totals, manager approval routing, and approval history screen.
longDescription: Professional services timesheet app built in Power Apps with Dataverse backend. Features: Monday–Friday grid with multiple time entries per day (project, task type: Development/Design/Meeting/Admin/Support, hours, note), running daily and weekly hour totals, weekly submit with lock-on-submit, Power Automate manager approval flow, and a history screen with Pending/Approved/Rejected status per past week. Suitable for consulting, agencies, legal, and IT services firms.

metadata.value: Create a weekly timesheet app with multi-entry time logging per day, project and task type selection, running totals, manager approval, and history screen.
